column2: [intro]
In the morning, in my car, I turn on the radio
And no surprise, who do I hear on it?
It's Katerine again with his nasal voice
I've heard enough, I'm fed up, damn it!
I like Katerine, it's true, it's funny
But I'm tired of hearing his songs all the time
His crazy universe, it's my thing
But sometimes, you need to take a break
When I go to the café, they always play his hits
"La Banane" and "Louxor j'adore", it's sad but true
I may find him genius and original
It gets boring, I need diversity
I like Katerine, it's true, it's funny
But I'm tired of hearing his songs all the time
His crazy universe, it's my thing
But sometimes, you need to take a break
[ solo ]
So Philippe, take a vacation, give us a little break
We love you, we appreciate you, but it's time for a pause
Come back with your genius when we least expect it
And your music will make us laugh again, I know it well!
[outro]
